method_notes.strip: ladder: quadrilaterals between the nearest points of two drawings on consecutive 25 m samples where the mean separation exceeds 30 m, union
method_notes.would_change: VA representative point inside the ladder region between the final line and a drawing
method_notes.pop_2021: area-weighted 2021 DA population proxy of the whole VA (not apportioned for cut VAs)
method_notes.ballots_cast: sum of the recorded candidate votes of the VA (2023 election-day layer)

disagreements_by_page_fit.note: in60 = share of the page's layer points within 60 m of the reference (edNN.json diagnostics); drawings from two different pages that differ by more than 30 m

calibration.note: class pairs list the lexicographically first class as 'first'; for two drawings of one class the order is arbitrary, use disagreements_by_page_fit
